fusions.name: Unshaped Wave
fusions.desc: Slams a wave of raw arcana that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores their resistances.

fusions.name: Probing Spark
fusions.desc: Flicks a spark at an enemy that deals 4 arcane damage, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Quickened Casting
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 8% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Pent Up
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
